prompt.text:
Implement a standard-library-only TypeScript module that converts navigation entries into immutable presentation rows.

Export exactly:
- `interface Palette { readonly foreground: string; readonly surface: string; readonly accent: string }`
- `interface NavigationEntry { readonly label: string; readonly destination: string; readonly glyph: string }`
- `interface NavigationRow { readonly label: string; readonly destination: string; readonly glyph: string; readonly foreground: string; readonly surface: string; readonly accent: string }`
- `const DEFAULT_PALETTE: Readonly<Palette>`
- `function buildNavigationRows(entries: readonly NavigationEntry[], palette?: Palette): readonly NavigationRow[]`

Use default colors `#242424`, `#f7f7f7`, and `#2962ff` for foreground, surface, and accent respectively.

Each entry field and each palette field must contain non-whitespace text; throw `TypeError` if any field is empty or malformed. Preserve strings and input ordering exactly. Duplicate destinations are allowed and remain separate rows. An empty entry array returns a frozen empty array. Copy all values into newly created frozen rows and return a frozen array, so later mutation of an input object or array cannot alter the result. Do not mutate the supplied entries or palette.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
